assignedProblems.title: Array Frequency Peak
assignedProblems.description: At the programming arena check-in, IoT sensors record participant badge scans as integer array tokens. Your task is to identify the badge token with the highest scan frequency. If multiple tokens share the maximum frequency, return the one with the smallest numeric value.
assignedProblems.inputFormat: A single line containing space-separated integers.
assignedProblems.outputFormat: A single integer denoting the peak frequency token.

sampleCases.explanation: Token 2 appears 3 times, which is the highest frequency.
Both 4 and 5 appear twice. Between 4 and 5, 4 is smaller.

assignedProblems.title: Valid Campus Token
assignedProblems.description: Campus Wi-Fi authentication tokens encode security credentials using bracketed permissions: '()', '[]', and '{}'. A token is valid if open brackets are closed by the same type of brackets in the correct order, and no bracket remains unclosed. Print 'VALID' if balanced, otherwise print 'INVALID'.
assignedProblems.inputFormat: A single string s consisting solely of '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']'.

sampleCases.explanation: All bracket pairs are correctly nested and ordered.
The closing bracket ')' precedes the closing bracket ']' of the inner block.

assignedProblems.title: Network Path Optimizer
assignedProblems.description: During peak contest network traffic across servers, data packets experience gains or losses in transmission energy (positive or negative integers). Find the contiguous sequence of packets that yields the maximum possible total net energy sum.
assignedProblems.inputFormat: A single line of space-separated integers representing packet energy differentials.
assignedProblems.outputFormat: A single integer denoting the maximum contiguous subarray sum.

sampleCases.explanation: Contiguous subarray [4, -1, 2, 1] has the largest sum = 6.
All numbers contribute to the maximum sum = 5 + 4 - 1 + 7 + 8 = 23.
